question.problem:
Let $X$ and $Y$ be two continuous random variables with a joint probability density function

$$
f(x,y)=\frac{1}{\pi {x}^{2}},\,{y}^{2}+1\le x.
$$

Find the expression for the marginal PDF ${f}_{Y}(y).$
question.worked_solution:
If $X$ and $Y$ are two continuous random variables with joint probability density function $f(x,y),$ then the marginal density functions for $X$ and $Y$ are

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{X}(x)={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }f(x,y)\,\text{d}y,\,{f}_{Y}(y)={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }f(x,y)\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$

First, let's sketch the region $D=\{(x,y)\,:\,{y}^{2}+1\le x\}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14154922/assets/0a75ec87c30ea5708201cb76816ea3a806648cec197195994cafbe9d9cf588d1.png)

In our case, the marginal density function of $Y$ for $-\infty <y<\infty $ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{Y}(y) & ={\int }_{{y}^{2}+1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{\pi {x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{\pi }{\int }_{{y}^{2}+1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{\pi }{lim}_{b\to \infty }{\int }_{{y}^{2}+1}^{b}\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{\pi }{lim}_{b\to \infty }{[-\frac{1}{x}]}_{x={y}^{2}+1}^{x=b} \\  & =-\frac{1}{\pi }{lim}_{b\to \infty }[\frac{1}{b}-\frac{1}{{y}^{2}+1}] \\  & =-\frac{1}{\pi }[0-\frac{1}{{y}^{2}+1}] \\  & =\frac{1}{\pi ({y}^{2}+1)}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the full expression for ${f}_{Y}(y)$ is given by

$$
{f}_{Y}(y)=\frac{1}{\pi ({y}^{2}+1)}.
$$
